dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A member of the Fatui? I didn't know you lot took the train too?

dialogues.speaker: Korchagin
dialogues.text: Why can't someone from the Fatui take the train...? Are we not of Snezhnaya too?

dialogues.speaker: Korchagin
dialogues.text: Besides, there are only certain situations where we can claim reimbursement for our travel expenses. I'm paying for this trip myself!
